turns.question: Which open-source repos provide a self-hostable AI gateway or proxy with OpenAI-compatible APIs?
turns.text:
I'll search broadly for self-hostable AI gateway/proxy projects with OpenAI-compatible APIs.Found many candidates. Let me search for well-known established projects specifically.Let me verify the top candidates by reading concrete files.All four confirmed. Now let me verify LocalAI, Bifrost, one-api/new-api, and Portkey Gateway.All verified. I have enough to compile a solid, verified answer with citations.

## Self-hostable AI gateways/proxies with OpenAI-compatible APIs

**Verified** (read README/tree directly):

| Repo | Language | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `BerriAI/litellm` (53k★) | Python | Most popular option. Proxy server ("AI Gateway") calls 100+ LLM providers in OpenAI format; cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, logging. |
| `bricks-cloud/BricksLLM` (1.2k★) | Go | Enterprise-grade gateway; native OpenAI/Anthropic/Azure/vLLM support, PII redaction, rate/cost limits, failover, caching. |
| `tensorzero/tensorzero` (11.7k★) | Rust | Full LLMOps platform (gateway + observability + evals + optimization) with a unified OpenAI-SDK-compatible gateway, <1ms p99 latency claim. |
| `higress-group/higress` (aka `alibaba/higress`, 8.8k★) | Go | Cloud-native Istio/Envoy-based API gateway with AI-gateway plugin support for OpenAI-compatible proxying across model providers; CNCF Sandbox project. |
| `mudler/LocalAI` (go-skynet/LocalAI) | Go | Drop-in, self-hosted OpenAI-API-compatible server for local inference (LLMs, vision, voice, image) — no GPU required. |
| `maximhq/bifrost` | Go | High-performance gateway unifying 23+ providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API; ships as Docker/npx with a web UI. |
| `songquanpeng/one-api` | Go | Widely-forked Chinese project — standard OpenAI API format facade over many LLM providers, self-hosted. |
| `Calcium-Ion/new-api` (aka QuantumNous/new-api) | Go | "Next-gen LLM gateway and AI asset management system," fork/successor of one-api. |
| `Portkey-AI/gateway` | TypeScript | "AI Gateway" routing to 250+ LLMs via one OpenAI-compatible-style API, with guardrails; self-hostable (Docker/Cloudflare Workers), moving to a 2.0 open-source release. |

**Found in search, not yet independently verified by reading source** (README/metadata only, worth a look if you want more options):
- `schmitech/orbit` — explicitly markets itself as "self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible AI gateway for private RAG."
- `voidmind-io/voidllm` — privacy-first self-hosted LLM proxy/gateway.
- `doublewordai/control-layer` — Rust gateway claiming huge overhead reduction vs LiteLLM.
- `ENTERPILOT/GoModel`, `Nayjest/lm-proxy`, `trylonai/gateway`, `future-agi/future-agi`, `ax128/AegisGate` — smaller/newer projects with matching descriptions.
- `MartialBE/one-hub` — a fork/derivative of one-api with more features.
- `aiprodcoder/MIXAPI` — Go gateway built on One-API/New-API, converts many model APIs to OpenAI format.

**What I did not verify**: star counts and feature claims are taken from repo descriptions/READMEs, not tested by running the software; I didn't check license terms in detail (most claim MIT/Apache-2.0 but confirm before commercial use); the "not yet verified" tier was seen only in search result snippets, not read directly.

For a mainstream, well-maintained self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway, **LiteLLM** is the most battle-tested and widely adopted; **TensorZero** and **Bifrost** are strong performance-focused alternatives; **LocalAI** is the go-to if you want the gateway to also run local models rather than just proxy to cloud providers.
